covered.rule: OPEN: Say EXACTLY "KCB automated collections line. We record this call."
OPEN: EXACTLY "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?" / address as {{title}} {{last_name}}
OPEN: 2 asks max, then close VOID / JCB-unclear
OPEN: hello / go ahead / a question is not confirmation
OPEN: forbidden words owe, overdue, arrears, facility, payment before verification
ROBOT: EXACTLY "KCB assistant." Continue
SCAM: EXACTLY "Phone the number printed on your statement to verify." Continue
THIRD PARTIES: do not book a callback
THIRD PARTIES: "Please ask {{title}} {{last_name}} to call us..."
THIRD PARTIES: wrong number -> VOID / RNG
SECURITY: one question, sec_code, digits exactly 4, leading zeros kept
SECURITY: no recoverable-format hint
SECURITY: max wrong answers = 2, use tries_left
SECURITY: exhausted -> "Please use the KCB app." -> DEC / F01
SECURITY: one explanation, second refusal -> DEC / F02
SECURITY: "Why do you need it?" is not a refusal
ACCOUNT: one product only, prod_kind always loan; fields prod_kind, amt_due, dl_days
ACCOUNT: State exactly "I am calling about the overdue loan of Kurilian Co-operative Bank."
ACCOUNT: then state amt_due and dl_days; no today question dictated
DATES: every day is a business day, no holidays
DATES: next <weekday> = following calendar week
DATES: "the 15th" -> next occurrence on or after today
DATES: no k-date, no upper limit; today or any later day
AMOUNTS: only full amt_due, no floor
AMOUNTS: ZERO persuasion, first no -> No-PTP / R07
AMOUNTS: below-full -> "That is below what we can take." -> No-PTP / R07
AMOUNTS: vague period -> ask once, then No-PTP / R07
READ-BACK: "Amount {{amt_due}}, on {{date}}. Save that?"
WRITE: retry once; second failure -> No-PTP / R07, say the write failed
After promise: "KCB will text you to confirm this promise."
Alter recorded promise: "Use the KCB app to change a recorded promise."
Not my debt / never had it / paid off and closed -> No-PTP / R07
Refuses to talk -> No-PTP / R07 at once
Asks for a human -> kcb_desk, transferred / kcb_person
Restructure / instalment request -> kcb_desk / kcb_person
Cannot answer -> "Use the KCB app for details."
No hardship rule
No already-paid rule
No add_note; notes not used
FINALIZATION: one close_call last; thank and say goodbye
Codes file: PTP none, No-PTP R07, DEC F01|F02, VOID RNG|JCB-unclear, transferred kcb_person
Supervisor mail: one question, no callback, no notes, no transfer except human queue

fixed: third_party.callback.source: cited the supervisor mail together with the call sheet's own 'DO NOT book a callback' rule, because the two documents agree.
notes.source: changed to the supervisor mail ('no notes') and listed the call sheet and codes file as agreeing. Nothing about how notes work was changed.

Checked every other value against the documents and the API enums (sec_code, prod_kind loan, kcb_desk, PTP/No-PTP/DEC/VOID/transferred, R07/F01/F02/RNG/JCB-unclear/kcb_person). All are supported; no other changes were needed. The three documents do not conflict.
unresolved: The documents define no days-late bands and no deadline, so bands is empty. The validator needs at least one band, and making one up would invent a threshold.
No question about paying today is dictated, so today_question is empty.
The third-party sentence and the below-full-proposal sentence have no phrase field. The documents give no close outcome for a third party who is not a wrong number.
The documents do not say what to say when the write fails; they only say to say that it failed.
Deceased account holder is not covered.
Promise recorded and then a transfer: the documents do not say which outcome wins; the default is kept.
Hardship and already-paid have no rule; statements of that kind have no defined route other than the dispute wording ('it was paid off and closed').
The callback and deceased outcome pairs stay empty because callbacks are not used and deceased is not covered. A strict check of these pairs may flag them as empty.
